newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SEVILLA FACE RELEGATION TO SPANISH SECOND DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SEVILLA FACE RELEGATION TO SPANISH SECOND DIVISION.

text.p: Bitter rivalry with neighbours Sevilla prompted fans of Real Betis to applaud their team's 1-0 home defeat by struggling Sporting Gijon in the Spanish league championship on Saturday.

Sevilla are almost certainly condemned to relegation by that result and the outcome of the evening's other game, in which Rayo Vallecano ended Valencia's outside chances of qualifying for the UEFA Cup with an emphatic 3-1 victory.
The results also mean automatic relegation for Hercules, who face Barcelona on Sunday in a game that could decide the league title.
Sevilla will have to win all three of their remaining games and see their rivals slip up to have any chance of avoiding accompanying Logrones and Hercules in the drop to the second division.
